title: 1 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 11
description: Ten questions on 1 Kings 11: Solomon's foreign wives, the adversaries Yahweh raised up, and Ahijah's torn garment for Jeroboam.

questions.text: Besides the daughter of Pharaoh, women of which peoples did Solomon love?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:1 says Solomon loved many foreign women, with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites.

answers.text: Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites

questions.text: How many wives and concubines did Solomon have?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:3 says he had seven hundred wives, princesses, and three hundred concubines.

answers.text: Three hundred wives and seven hundred concubines
One hundred wives and two hundred concubines
Seven hundred wives and three hundred concubines

questions.text: Ashtoreth, whom Solomon went after, is called the goddess of which people?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:5 says Solomon went after Ashtoreth the goddess of the Sidonians.

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he would do because Solomon had not kept his covenant?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 11:11 Yahweh says he will surely tear the kingdom from Solomon and give it to his servant.

answers.text: Send a famine on the land for three years
Destroy the temple Solomon had built
Tear the kingdom from him and give it to his servant
Let Egypt carry Israel away into captivity

questions.text: Why would Yahweh not tear the kingdom away in Solomon's own days?
questions.explanation: In 1 Kings 11:12 Yahweh says he will not do it in Solomon's days, for David his father's sake.

answers.text: Because Solomon had built the temple
Because the people prayed for him

questions.text: Whom did Pharaoh give to Hadad the Edomite as his wife?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:19 says Pharaoh gave Hadad as wife the sister of his own wife, the sister of Tahpenes the queen.

answers.text: The sister of Tahpenes the queen
A daughter of the king of Edom
A princess from the land of Midian

questions.text: Where did Rezon and his men live and reign?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:24 says they went to Damascus, lived there, and reigned in Damascus.

questions.text: Into how many pieces did the prophet Ahijah tear his new garment?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:30 says Ahijah took the new garment that was on him and tore it in twelve pieces.

questions.text: Where did Jeroboam flee when Solomon sought to kill him?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:40 says Jeroboam fled into Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt, and was in Egypt until the death of Solomon.

answers.text: To Egypt, to Shishak king of Egypt
To Edom, to Hadad the Edomite

questions.text: Who reigned in Solomon's place after he died?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 11:43 says Solomon slept with his fathers, was buried in David's city, and Rehoboam his son reigned in his place.
